case_title: State Through Deputy Superintendent Of Police v. R. Soundirarasu Etc.
statutory_provisions: PC Act s.13(2) r/w 13(1)(e); IPC s.109
offence_finally_established: Criminal misconduct under PC Act s.13(2) r/w 13(1)(e)
neutral_facts: The accused, a public servant, was investigated for acquiring assets disproportionate to his known sources of income. A First Information Report (FIR) was registered against him for alleged criminal misconduct under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988. During the investigation, the role of his wife as an abettor surfaced. A charge sheet was filed, and the accused filed a petition under Section 239 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, seeking discharge. The Special Judge rejected the petition, finding a prima facie case against the accused. The High Court discharged the accused, but the Supreme Court overturned this decision, stating that the charge was not groundless and that the accused should be put to trial.
